inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Salt in the air, phone face down
Sun melting slow, gold to brown
Footprints fade where the waves run through
Everything loud, except me and you

[Pre-Chorus]
Breathing with the tide tonight
Heart on low, city out of sight
If I disappear for a while
I’m just learning how to be quiet

[Chorus]
Let the ocean take the weight
I don’t need to rush my fate
Neon thoughts, drifting free
I’m right here, the sea and me
Hold the moment, don’t explain
I’m lighter every time it breaks
No tomorrow, no regret
Just the waves, just the breath

[Verse]
Streetlight stars in my memory
Fast life moving too fast for me
Every dream wants more than it gives
Tonight I’m fine with how this lives

[Pre-Chorus]
Low tide pulling at my fears
All the noise dissolves right here
If the world keeps calling my name
I’ll let it ring, I’ll stay the same

[Chorus]
Let the ocean take the weight
I don’t need to rush my fate
Neon thoughts, drifting free
I’m right here, the sea and me
Hold the moment, don’t explain
I’m lighter every time it breaks
No tomorrow, no regret
Just the waves, just the breath

[Bridge]
If I fall apart, let it be slow
Like moonlight sinking below
I don’t need saving tonight
I’m learning how to float, not fight

[Outro]
Just the waves
Just the breath
I’m not lost
I’m not there yet
